wiki.title: Terry Wanzek
wiki.extract: Terry Wanzek (born March 28, 1957) is an American politician. He is a member of the North Dakota State Senate from the 29th District, serving since 2007. He is a member of the Republican party. He also served in the Senate from 1995 to 2003, and in the House of Representatives from 1992 to 1994.
